After a tour of the facilities, during which we learned all about the Anti-Cruelty Society’s good work, we got to meet two of its residents! We were all enamored with Cookie the dog and Tom the cat.

title: In Case You Missed It: A Conversation on Tax Planning, Exit Strategy & Long-Term Growth
body_html:
We’re grateful for the strong engagement and thoughtful discussion following Jeremy’s recent podcast appearance on From Boots to Boardroom. It was a meaningful conversation covering topics that matter deeply to founders and operators including tax planning, exit strategy, wealth protection, and sustainable business growth.

These are not just theoretical concepts. They are practical, real-world considerations that can significantly influence how a business is structured, scaled, and ultimately positioned for long-term success. During the episode, Jeremy shares actionable insights and perspective drawn from working closely with entrepreneurs navigating exactly these challenges.

If you haven’t had a chance to listen yet, we encourage you to tune in. There’s a wealth of practical guidance designed to help business owners make informed, strategic decisions about their companies and their futures.

title: Jeremy Dubow, CEO of Prosperity Partners, Talks Private Equity and Growth on the Accounting ARC Podcast
body_html:
In a recent episode of the Accounting ARC podcast, our CEO Jeremy Dubow shared insights on how private equity has been a driving force behind Prosperity Partners’ growth and innovative approach to accounting. Hosted by Donny Shimamoto, the podcast delved into the unique path Prosperity has taken to redefine the accounting profession.

Jeremy, who co-founded the firm in 2003 as NDH Advisors, explained how the company evolved after selling a stake to Unity Partners in 2023, rebranding as Prosperity Partners. He highlighted the firm’s focus on transformative technologies and a people-first culture as key factors in its success.

With private equity backing, Prosperity Partners has been able to streamline operations and focus on areas that drive significant value for clients. Through this innovative approach, the firm is redefining what an accounting firm can achieve in today’s ever-evolving market.

Listen to the full podcast episode to learn more about how Prosperity Partners is leading the charge in the accounting profession: https://cpatrendlines.com/2025/01/16/private-equity-as-a-catalyst-for-growth-arc/

title: Jeremy Dubow Discusses Transformational Power of Private Equity in Accounting Today’s Latest Article
body_html:
At Accounting Today’s Private Equity Summit, our CEO Jeremy Dubow shared how private equity (PE) has driven transformation within Prosperity Partners. Dubow discussed how Prosperity’s journey began with outreach and due diligence, ultimately leading to a partnership with Unity Partners LLC in 2023. He emphasized that private equity isn’t just about financial investment but about creating value for both the firm and its employees, allowing everyone to share in the firm’s growth.

Dubow also stressed the importance of exploring all options before committing to PE, advising firms not to jump in without careful consideration. He explained how private equity helped Prosperity think differently about technology and people, enabling our firm to accelerate change and become a “firm of the future.”

For a deeper dive into the discussion, check out the full article by Danielle Lee summarizing the PE Summit panel:
https://www.accountingtoday.com/news/can-pe-buy-transformation

title: NDH Advisors Rebrands as Prosperity Partners
body_html:
CHICAGO —September 4, 2024 — NDH Advisors LLC (“NDH”), a Chicago-headquartered accounting firm, today announced that the company has rebranded as Prosperity Partners, a name that aligns with the firm’s core values, commitment to top-tier client service and mission to be the leading destination for tax and accounting talent.

Founded in 2003 as “NDH” by three former Big Four tax professionals seeking to build a better accounting firm, the company quickly developed a reputation as a people-first organization that provides the highest caliber tax and accounting services to its sophisticated clientele. In 2023, following an equity investment from Unity Partners, a Dallas-based private equity firm, NDH scaled its platform by investing heavily in infrastructure and technology and adding offices in Kansas City, Houston, Philadelphia, Santa Barbara, Detroit, and Washington D.C.

“The Prosperity Partners brand better captures the values, culture and ambitions of our organization, as shown in our recent accelerated growth —both ​organic and through strategic partnerships with other visionary leaders,” said Jeremy Dubow, CEO and co-founder of Prosperity Partners. “We’re proud to earn the trust of a growing number of partners and employees, while continuing to be the premier advisor to our outstanding clients.”

All employees of Prosperity Partners become part of Prosperity’s Employee Purpose Plan, a broad-based employee ownership program that allows employees to benefit from the company’s success.

“Our motto is ‘Together, let’s chase new horizons, create fresh opportunities, and shape a future where prosperity knows no bounds,” said Courtney Jones, head of Prosperity’s Kansas City office. “This statement resonates equally with our employees and clients, both of whom rely on us to be compassionate, innovative and accessible in meeting their needs and helping them prosper.”

“Since our investment in NDH eighteen months ago, we have prioritized implementing our ‘Partner & Propel’ strategy to accelerate growth and to identify partners who embrace our goal of building better together as we expand the company’s footprint,” said Peter Cozzi, Team Lead at Unity Partners. “Now, with well over 100 employees in seven offices, we’re excited to go to market with a brand that speaks to Prosperity’s capabilities and growth.”

# # #

About Prosperity Partners
Prosperity Partners is a best-in-class, tax and accounting firm serving dynamic businesses, high net-worth individuals, and family offices throughout the United States. With offices in Chicago, Philadelphia, Houston, Kansas City, Santa Barbara, Detroit, and Washington D.C., and a growing team of talented professionals, Prosperity provides tax advisory, tax consulting, tax preparation, valuation, outsourced back-office accounting, fractional CFO, litigation support and start-up business services. For more information, visit prosperityllc.com.

About Unity Partners
Unity Partners is a principles-based private equity firm that partners investors and operators to build better together, measured by the economic surplus we create and share with all stakeholders. Our principles provide a foundation to build great people-based services and technology organizations that impact thousands of lives. We deploy our Partner & Propel strategy to identify opportunities to Partner with ambitious leaders to accelerate growth, unlock the benefits of platform scale through mergers and acquisitions and Propel value acceleration through investments in people, processes, and operational levers. For more information, visit unitypartnerslp.com.

title: Prosperity Partners Announces Strategic Partnership with Jain & Jain
body_html:
Addition Of Tax & Accounting Firm Drives Significant Growth

DALLAS—January 30, 2024—Unity Partners LP (“Unity Partners”), a principles-based private equity firm, and Prosperity Partners Advisors LLC (“Prosperity Partners”), a Chicago-headquartered accounting business, today announced that Prosperity Partners has partnered with Houston-based tax and accounting firm Jain & Jain P.C. (“Jain & Jain”). Terms of the private transaction were not disclosed.

Established in 1986 by founders Mike and Rajni Jain, Jain & Jain provides tax and outsourced accounting services to high net-worth individuals, closely-held businesses and their owners and family groups. Jain & Jain’s clients are primarily based in Texas, Florida, Utah, and Kansas and represent a diverse mix of industries. Both founders will continue to be actively involved in the business.

“This transaction complements Prosperity Partners’ core service offering and allows us to add talented professionals to our growing team,” said Jeremy Dubow, CEO and co-founder of Prosperity Partners. “Mike and Rajni are passionate and experienced business owners with values that align with ours. As well-respected leaders and best-in-class advisors, they will help Prosperity Partners expand its business in Texas and the surrounding states.”

Consistent with Prosperity Partners’ people-first focus, all Jain & Jain employees will become part of Prosperity Partners’ Employee Purpose Plan, a broad-based employee ownership program. As an essential aspect of each Unity Partners’ investment, the employee ownership plan allows qualifying employees to benefit from the company’s success.

“The Jain & Jain team is thrilled to partner with Prosperity Partners’ outstanding professionals, as we combine businesses to provide the highest quality tax and accounting services to clients throughout the country,” said Mike Jain. “Our shared resources and industry expertise will strengthen Prosperity Partners’ ability to offer to employees exceptional professional growth opportunities while also helping clients meet their complex tax and financial needs.

“With strong alignment on growth ambitions, the Unity team quickly realized the opportunity to partner Jain & Jain with Prosperity Partners to further execute our Partner & Propel strategy,” said Peter Cozzi, Team Lead at Unity Partners. “We believe the addition of Jain & Jain to the Prosperity Partners platform is a great opportunity to leverage Prosperity Partners’ resources and expertise to help an already successful business offer an even better experience to its clients and employees.”

Our principles provide a foundation to build great people-based services and technology organizations that impact thousands of lives. title: Prosperity Partners CEO Jeremy Dubow on LumiQ Podcast! (part one of two)
body_html:
A Case Study on the Accounting & Private Equity Firm Partnership: Part 1

How Two Accounting Firms Became Involved With Private Equity to Reach New Levels of Growth

In the first episode of this two-part series, LumiQ delves into the journeys of Prosperity Partners and Smith + Howard, two accounting firms striving for unprecedented transformation and growth. How do they plan to do it? Through strategic partnerships with two private equity firms: Unity and Broad Sky Partners. Allan Koltin, CEO of Koltin Consulting Group, a leading M&A consultant in the accounting sector, also joins to offer unique insights into the significant changes that have swept through this industry over the past three years. He sheds light on the emerging trend of PE partnerships with accounting firms and the intricate processes involved.

In this episode, they cover:

  • The challenges both accounting firms faced in talent acquisition and technology adoption
  • The benefits and solutions that PE was able to offer to Prosperity Partners and Smith + Howard
  • The different categories of accounting firms and their readiness for a PE partnership

title: Prosperity Partners Completes Acquisition of McGowan Guntermann
body_html:
Acquisition of Tax & Accounting Firm Bolsters Prosperity Partners’ Services and Establishes Presence in Santa Barbara

DALLAS—June 04, 2024—Unity Partners LP (“Unity Partners”), a principles-based private equity firm, and Prosperity Partners Advisors LLC (“Prosperity Partners”), a Chicago-headquartered accounting business, today announced that Prosperity Partners has completed the acquisition of Santa Barbara-based tax and accounting firm McGowan Guntermann P.C. (“McGowan”). Terms of the private transaction were not disclosed.

Established in 1945 and now led by David Larson, McGowan provides tax and outsourced accounting services to high net-worth individuals, closely held businesses and their owners, and family groups. The current partners of McGowan will remain actively involved in the business going forward.

“We are thrilled to add the entire McGowan team to the Prosperity Partners family,” said Jeremy Dubow, CEO and co-founder of Prosperity Partners. “Managing Partner David Larson and his partners are talented and experienced leaders who run a high-quality business. Our client and service areas are very complementary and, more importantly, our firm cultures are well aligned.”

Consistent with Prosperity Partners’ people-first focus, all McGowan employees will become part of Prosperity Partners’ Employee Purpose Plan, a broad-based employee ownership program. As an essential aspect of each Unity Partners’ investment, the employee ownership plan allows qualifying employees to benefit from the company’s success.

“We were impressed by the Prosperity Partners team and the level of expertise and resources they could bring to bear,” said Larson. “Prosperity Partners is the right cultural and strategic fit for McGowan, and we believe our employees and clients will both benefit from being part of this team.”

“We’re confident that McGowan will be a fantastic addition to the Prosperity Partners platform,” said Peter Cozzi, Team Lead at Unity Partners. “It is exciting to see the Prosperity Partners team continue to attract such great partners, and we believe it is a testament to their ability to help already successful firms offer an even better experience to clients and employees.”

title: Prosperity Partners Acquires Cendrowski Corporate Advisors!
body_html:
We’re proud to announce our partnership with Cendrowski Corporate Advisors (CCA)! We’re excited to have everyone in the Bloomfield Hills office on the team and look forward to a rewarding and prosperous future together.

Founded in 1983 by Harry Cendrowski, CCA is a boutique tax consulting firm offering comprehensive tax, outsourced accounting, family office services, business valuation, dispute advisory and forensic accounting services to its sophisticated clientele. The current partners of CCA will remain actively involved and are fully committed to the business.

“We are excited to add the CCA team to the Prosperity Partners family,” said Jeremy Dubow, CEO and co-founder of Prosperity. “Harry Cendrowski and his partners have developed a fantastic reputation in our industry, built on decades of delivering high-quality service and expertise to their clients. They have a great team and a complementary service offering that will benefit the Prosperity platform.”

Consistent with Prosperity’s people-first focus, all CCA employees will become part of Prosperity’s Employee Purpose Plan, a broad-based employee ownership program. As an essential aspect of each Unity Partners’ investment, the employee ownership plan allows qualifying employees to benefit from the company’s success.

“Prosperity Partners impressed us with their track-record of growth, breadth of resources, and deep focus on employee and client success,” said Harry Cendrowski. “We believe that Prosperity is the right cultural and strategic fit for CCA and that our employees and clients will benefit from being part of this organization.

title: Prosperity Partners Merges in Farkouh, Furman & Faccio
body_html:
CHICAGO— Prosperity Partners (“Prosperity”), a Chicago-headquartered tax and accounting business backed by private equity firm Unity Partners LP (“Unity Partners”), today announced that it has completed the addition of New York-based Farkouh, Furman & Faccio (“FF&F” or “the Company”), a provider of tax, attest, accounting and business consulting services. The Company’s partners are reinvesting in Prosperity as part of the transaction. Financial terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.

Founded in 1974, FF&F serves a geographically diverse, sophisticated clientele, including domestic and international businesses, high-net-worth individuals and ultra-high-net-worth families. Combining top-tier technical expertise with superior client service, the Company has enjoyed consistent growth and long-term client relationships.

“We are honored that Farkouh, Furman & Faccio, with its stellar reputation and talented professionals, has joined Prosperity, establishing a new flagship office in New York City,” said Jeremy Dubow, CEO and co-founder of Prosperity. “FF&F brings excellent service credentials, strong relationships and new subject matter expertise to our platform. As part of Prosperity, FF&F will gain operational leverage through our technology investments and access to our accomplished offshore team. ”

With this addition, Prosperity gains a dedicated audit team and international tax expertise – two new capabilities that will greatly benefit Prosperity’s existing clients.

“While we’ve run a successful accounting firm for several decades, Prosperity provides a compelling path forward to grow our business, expand service offerings and create greater opportunity for our professionals,” said founding partner Fred Farkouh. “The entire team is energized to participate in Prosperity’s equity compensation plan and to be part of one of the fastest growing accounting firms in the country.”

FF&F’s seven partners and 38 employees have joined Prosperity as part of the transaction. All FF&F employees will participate in Prosperity’s Employee Purpose Plan, a broad employee ownership program that allows employees to benefit from the company’s future success.

“Prosperity’s people-first culture ensures that our team will be greatly supported and provided with new pathways to grow their careers,” added FF&F Managing Partner Bruce Militzok. “The broad employee ownership plan, combined with a firm-wide focus on technology and training, will enable our team to continue delivering superior client service while rewarding their contributions to the firm’s success.”
